senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; קשש to be hard, stiff; cmp. קָשֶׁה) straw, stubble.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Shabbat 3:1">Sabb. III, 1</cite> <he>בקש ובגבבא</he> with straw or rakings.
<cite ref="Shabbat 66a:13">Ib. 66ᵃ</cite> <he>כוורת של קש</he>; <cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 15:1">Kel. XV, 1</cite> <he>כוורת הקש</he>, v. <cite ref="K00220"><he>כְּוֶורֶת</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Mishnah Kelim 17:17">Ib. XVII, 17</cite>, v. <cite ref="U01724"><he>שְׁפוֹפֶרֶת</he></cite>. Y. Peah IV, beg. 18ᵃ <he>הנח … בקַשָּׁהּ</he> leave for them (the poor) the grain with its straw (stalks); a. fr.—[<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 9:8">Tosef. Sabb. IX</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 10:2">X</cite>), 2 <he>הקש שבחזיר</he> some ed. the stiff bristle &c., v. <cite ref="S02221"><he>קָשֶׁה</he></cite>.]—Pl. <he>קַשִּׁים</he>, <he>קַשִּׁין</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 5:6:4">Y. Peah V, end, 19ᵃ</cite> <he>בזוכר את הק׳</he> when he recalls the straw (with which he covered the sheaves).
